data.title: Kraken Robotics Announces $102 Million in New Orders
data.description: Announced orders now total $457 million in 2026, Q3 results to be released November 24TORONTO, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kraken Robotics Inc. (“Kraken” or the “Company”) (TSX-V: PNG, OTCQB: KRKNF) is pleased to announce continued strength in new order activity with $102 million of new orders since its last update on August 27, 2026.
